name: Probhat
_source: Transcribed from the canonical X11 definition xkb_symbols "ben_probhat" in /usr/share/X11/xkb/symbols/in (xkb-data), which is the Probhat layout shipped by Linux distributions and derived from the scheme published by ankurbangla.org. Levels 1 (base), 2 (shift) and 3 (AltGr / right Alt) are reproduced in full.
_verified: Checked key-for-key against that definition on 2026-09-26. An earlier draft of this file was 72% correct: the home and top letter rows were right, but the Z row, most punctuation and the whole AltGr level were wrong or absent.
_notes: Hasant is on '/' (not 'z' as the draft assumed) - press it between two consonants to build a conjunct.
Nukta is on AltGr+'.' and the rupee sign on AltGr+'r'.
` is ZWJ and \ is ZWNJ: they force or forbid a conjunct ligature without adding a letter.
Precomposed codepoints are used where Probhat specifies them: R gives U+09DC and X gives U+09DD, not the decomposed consonant plus nukta.
